scope.applicable_only_when: antecedent_mode == EXPLICIT_RULE_REFERENCE and antecedent_rule_ids were source-adjudicated

semantics.reference_identity: Rule IDs are authoritative. Text adjacency MUST NOT create an antecedent edge.

surface_classes.EXACT_FOREGOING_REFERENCE: The target clause is an explicit `前格` continuation. Preserve the source-adjudicated parent ID; do not infer a parent from nearest text.
surface_classes.FOREGOING_REFERENCE_WITH_SOURCE_LOCAL_CO: The target begins with `前格` and retains additional source text as a local continuation/delta. The delta is not automatically compiled merely because the parent is known.
surface_classes.EXPLICIT_SOURCE_LOCAL_ADDITIVE_CONTINUAT: The source explicitly adds a condition to a source-adjudicated parent without using `前格`; currently represented only by CA09-847.

parent_compositions.SINGLE_PARENT: Inherit from exactly one explicit antecedent rule ID.
parent_compositions.SOURCE_BRANCH_UNION_SHARED_QUALIFIER: Apply a local qualifier over alternative source branches. Parent IDs are OR/branch-union context, never implicit AND. Currently required by CA05-473.

blocker_propagation.rule: A dependency target cannot become condition-ready by reference resolution alone if any required parent branch, transitive antecedent, or local continuation remains source-underdetermined.
blocker_propagation.single_parent: Propagate unresolved parent blocker metadata transitively across explicit-reference chains; do not delete or rewrite any parent blocker.
blocker_propagation.branch_union: Track readiness per parent branch. A shared qualifier does not convert alternative branches into conjunction. Any executable branch would separately require a source-resolved parent and source-resolved local qualifier.
blocker_propagation.local_blockers: All target blockers other than ANTECEDENT_DEPENDENCY remain independently binding.

readiness_bands.REFERENCE_EDGE_RESOLVED_INHERITED_SOURCE: The explicit reference edge is source-resolved and the target has no row-local blocker, but one or more required parent/ancestor conditions remain source-underdetermined.
readiness_bands.REFERENCE_EDGE_RESOLVED_LOCAL_BLOCKERS_R: The explicit reference edge is source-resolved but the target still has independent row-local blockers.
readiness_bands.REFERENCE_EDGE_RESOLVED_PARENT_SCOPE_NOT: The explicit reference edge is source-resolved, but a required parent lies outside this contextual-activation closure and is not treated as ready by absence of blocker metadata.
readiness_bands.REFERENCE_EDGE_RESOLVED_EFFECTIVE_CONDIT: Reserved for a reference-resolved target with no local blockers, complete parent assessment, and no inherited parent blockers. Current count is zero.
readiness_bands.DEPENDENCY_ONLY_PARENT_READY: The only current target blocker is ANTECEDENT_DEPENDENCY; parent assessment is complete and effective parent blockers are empty. Knowledge-side compiler candidate only.
readiness_bands.DEPENDENCY_ONLY_INHERITS_SOURCE_UNDERDET: The only target blocker is ANTECEDENT_DEPENDENCY, but a required parent or ancestor remains source-underdetermined.
readiness_bands.DEPENDENCY_ONLY_PARENT_SCOPE_NOT_ASSESSE: The only target blocker is ANTECEDENT_DEPENDENCY, but a required parent is outside this closure's readiness assessment.
readiness_bands.DEPENDENCY_COMPILER_PLUS_LOCAL_BLOCKERS: The target has ANTECEDENT_DEPENDENCY plus independent row-local blockers and remains blocked even if graph traversal is implemented.

row_local_vs_effective_readiness.rule: Closure readiness_class is row-local and MUST NOT be interpreted as recursively compiled dependency readiness.
row_local_vs_effective_readiness.effective_dependency_rule: Effective dependency readiness recursively propagates source-underdetermined blockers across explicit antecedent chains before any compiler candidate can be called parent-ready.
row_local_vs_effective_readiness.outside_closure_rule: A parent outside the contextual-activation closure is NOT silently considered ready; it is marked not assessed by this closure and remains non-executable unless another canonical artifact establishes its condition readiness.

required_product_behavior_if_implemented: Consume explicit rule IDs, not text adjacency.
Compute dependency readiness recursively, not from the target row's local blocker list alone.
Propagate unresolved parent and ancestor blockers fail-closed.
Treat parent-outside-closure as unassessed, not blocker-free.
Do not create global semantics from 前格, 更见, 又见, 同时见 or other surface tokens.
Keep branch-local provenance in outputs and tests.

critic_correction.issue: Initial draft labeled 11 already-reference-resolved rows as RULE_READY based only on row-local blockers. That label ignored inherited parent uncertainty and was semantically unsafe.
critic_correction.correction: Readiness is now split into row-local closure readiness versus effective dependency readiness. Parent blocker propagation is transitive across explicit-reference chains. CA02-171 therefore inherits OPEN_VALENCE_CATEGORY_ACTIVATION_CONTEXTUAL_UNRESOLVED through CA02-170 -> CA02-169.
critic_correction.invariant: No explicit-reference row is called condition-ready merely because its own row-local blocker list is empty.
